subject: PO assignment & spend cap for Veridian Cloud onboarding
messages:
From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@veridiancloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Veridian Cloud Billing <billing@veridiancloud.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: PO number & spend cap for onboarding

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Procurement at Veridian needs a formal PO number and the approved spend cap to start the contract and route funds. Were ready to proceed with the onboarding packet but need three items to push the purchase order:

- Official PO number that matches Redwoods billing ledger
- Confirmed spend cap (monthly and total or initial allocation)
- Billing contact + invoice cadence

Ive attached our filled onboarding form (veridian_onboard_form_v2.pdf) and the W-9. Can you confirm next steps and if we should expect the PO number today?

Appreciate it — Sophie

--
Sophie Tan
Head of Operations, Veridian Cloud
sophie.tan@veridiancloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0199
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@veridiancloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:57:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number & spend cap for onboarding

Thanks Sophie — quick confirmation.

On our side we typically require: onboarding form, W-9, and the signed SOW/ordering agreement before issuing a provisional PO number for activation. I see the onboarding form and W-9 attached (thanks). I dont have the signed ordering agreement yet — Monica, can you advise on the redline status?

If procurement at Veridian needs a temporary reference to kick off internal routing I can request a provisional PO (internal-only) but it will be replaced by the final PO that matches the signed agreement. That provisional PO can accept up to $40k/month as a temporary spend cap while legal finishes the doc review, unless you want a stricter limit.

Provisional option requires a 2–3 hour SLT approval today; final PO issuance requires the signed doc and takes 1 business day.

Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@veridiancloud.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number & spend cap for onboarding

On Fri, Aug 19, 2026 at 09:57 AM, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks Sophie — quick confirmation.
> 
> On our side we typically require: onboarding form, W-9, and the signed SOW/ordering agreement before issuing a provisional PO number for activation. I see the onboarding form and W-9 attached (thanks). I don't have the signed ordering agreement yet — Monica, can you advise on the redline status?

Hi all — forwarded the redlines to Veridian earlier this morning (wc_agreement_redlined.docx). Sophie, I attached the redlined copy for visibility. Legal accepted three small edits (payment term clarified to Net 45; data residency clause preserved; and an SLA appendix placeholder). If Veridian signs the current redline without further edits we can:

1) Issue a provisional PO reference PO-RD-2026-0830-PROV (internal/procurement start only) today after SLT sign-off.
2) Set temporary spend cap to $40,000/month and $120,000 initial allocation (can be lowered to $25k/month on request).
3) Final PO (PO-RD-2026-0830-FINAL) will be issued within 1 business day after we receive the fully executed agreement and final billing contact.

Sophie — please confirm acceptance of the three redlines or send any last comments by EOD today so we can expedite approval. Rishi — please route the provisional PO to procurement if Sophie confirms; include the onboarding packet in the procurement ticket.

Thanks,
Monica
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@veridiancloud.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Veridian Cloud Billing <billing@veridiancloud.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number & spend cap for onboarding

Thanks Monica — we reviewed the redlines and accept them as-is.

Please proceed with the provisional PO and the temporary spend cap of $40,000/month. We will sign the redlined SOW today and return the fully executed copy to billing@redwoodinference.com by end of day.

Requested: can you confirm the provisional PO reference and the invoice cadence (monthly invoices, Net 45) in your confirmation email so our procurement team has everything they need to create the formal purchase order internally?

Attached: signed onboarding form (veridian_onboard_form_v2.pdf) and W-9 (veridian_w9.pdf).

Best,
Sophie

--
Sophie Tan
Head of Operations, Veridian Cloud
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@veridiancloud.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: PO issued: PO-RD-2026-0830-PROV / spend cap confirmation

Following Sophie’s confirmation, procurement has issued the provisional PO reference and created the ticket.

PO reference: PO-RD-2026-0830-PROV
Temporary spend cap: $40,000/month (initial allocation $120,000)
Invoice cadence: Monthly, Net 45
Next steps:
- Sophie: please upload fully executed SOW to procurement ticket or email to billing@redwoodinference.com.
- Procurement: will convert the provisional PO to final PO-RD-2026-0830-FINAL within 1 business day after receipt of executed SOW.
- Note: line-item mapping in our ledger currently shows two item codes for onboarding services (ONB-SVC and ONB-SETUP). Monica, please confirm if billing should collapse to a single line or we should track two lines for cost-center tagging.

Rishi
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
